data.written: 2026-10-13, pin 14 v6 (FAILURE_LOG F46): head3's v2_0r (run 20261013_040232) has his head, his janeu and his skin, and passes the whole-pin pose gate, but its shoulders are narrower than his pumped front standard and his side-lit photos at one scale. Measured (character.measure and YOLO11m-seg, widths across the torso axis per torso length): the render's silhouette is 0.713 at the shoulder line and 0.81 at 15 percent down; the pin man's 0.643 / 0.762; his standard pumped_front 0.987 / 1.027, his side-lit photos IMG_7006 / 7002 / 7005 0.89-0.91 / 0.94-0.98 (IMG_7008, a close photo, 1.15 / 1.17); turned about 25 degrees like the pin man (x cos = 0.906) his silhouette would read 0.89 / 0.93 (the standard) and 0.81-0.83 / 0.85-0.89 (the photos): the render is 14-25 percent short at the shoulder line and 5-15 percent short 15 percent down. His near upper arm is not thinner: the ATR arm width over torso length is 0.225 on the render (head3 v2_0r) against 0.188-0.189 on the standard and 0.217-0.225 on IMG_7006 and IMG_7008, so the arm item asks for his veins and pumped definition and for 'never thinner', not for a wider arm. The gap is more than 7 percent, so the widening asked for is 6 percent (the render's shoulder line 0.713 to about 0.756), the most the pose gate leaves room for: torso length x0.95 (limits 0.93-1.07), his left forearm 12 degrees off (limit 15), his left upper arm 6 degrees off. The paste mask (tools/region_edit.py, .cache/region_edits/pin14_body2): the pin man's YOLO person mask united with the render's, grown 17 px (about 8 percent of the 212 px body width at the chest) down to y 800, 8 px below; the head, cap and neck keep their pixels (soft mask 0 above the neck line, a 10 px ramp below it); the band where the hillside and grass are repainted is that growth. References as pin 14 v4: his pumped front cut to the torso (no face) and three crops of his own side-lit photos, each labelled for what it shows, never for pose. Check sheet: scratchpad pin14_probe/body2_mask.jpg.
